method_card.mechanism: Subtract each paired reference voltage from the sensor reading.
method_card.objective: Quantify signed bias and error magnitude by observed period.
method_card.estimator: Arithmetic mean signed and absolute errors, and square root of the mean squared error, in mV.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Deterministic arithmetic on user-supplied CSV rows.

manifest.limitations: Descriptive comparisons apply to the recorded samples and supplied references. Attribution of drift requires suitable controls and additional sampling.
